claims.claim: Neatly used Lumix G7 mirrorless camera.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Panasonic LUMIX mirrorless-style camera body, but the exact model number “G7” is not readable.
Witness photos show the camera and an accessory card/box set, but no clear view of two batteries and a charger.
Witness did not verify the seller’s stated location.
No shutter count/EXIF/onscreen counter is shown in the provided photos.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show enough lens close-up/inspection to confirm fungus/haze/scratches.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No proof of originality (labels/serials) or repair history is shown.

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (photos don’t confirm “G7”); pricing depends heavily on the specific Lumix model and kit configuration.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model text/label (e.g., on the body) and/or the menu “About/Model” screen showing “G7”.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Panasonic LUMIX mirrorless with unknown model and unknown kit/accessories.

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown (fungus, haze, scratches) which can drastically reduce value and usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass at multiple angles under light, plus a video clip showing focus and zoom with the lens cap off.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case lens condition (assume possible haze/fungus) and treat as needing inspection.

risks.risk: Camera may not fully work (buttons/dials, autofocus, zoom, flash, hot-shoe functionality).
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus lock, zoom in/out, flash test, and recording playback.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty until functional tests are shown.

risks.risk: Battery health and completeness unknown (number of batteries, whether they hold charge, whether charger is included and works).
risks.proof: Photos of both batteries with labels/serials and a clip showing charging indicator/charging working.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming batteries/charger may be incomplete or weak (worst-case: only one working battery or charger not included).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (caps, strap, manuals, memory card, USB cable) affect total value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item (memory card, charger/USB, caps, strap, manuals) with clear counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included accessories (no memory card/USB/manuals unless shown).

risks.risk: Shutter count claim not verifiable from photos; higher usage can lower resale value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the shutter count from the camera menu or a connected software readout.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher usage/unknown shutter count.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera body label showing the exact model (confirm “G7”).
Close-up lens photos (front and rear elements) under bright light to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Video clip: power on → menu → autofocus test → zoom in/out → flash test → record and playback.
Photos showing both batteries and the charger (labels/serials) and a clip proving the charger charges.
Photo/screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or software readout.
Lay-out photo of all included accessories (memory card type/capacity, USB cable, caps, strap, manuals).
response.reason: The witness confirms a Panasonic LUMIX camera, but the key details needed to price confidently (exact model “G7”, lens condition, full functionality, included batteries/charger, shutter count) are not verifiable from the provided photos.
